// diagnostic

E3521

Two writers at the same contribution layer gave different values for `{fact}`; both source locations are shown.

What

Two writers at the same contribution layer gave different values for `{fact}`; both source locations are shown.

Why

Cross-layer overrides are legal, but same-layer disagreement is ambiguous and cannot be selected by source order.

Fix

Make the named writers agree, or move one value to a more explicit contribution layer.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3521: tests/ui/fact_contribution_conflict/stderr.

Error [jet.BuildFactConflict]: Fact `Build.Settings.cache_slots` has conflicting values at the environment layer
  --> tests/ui/fact_contribution_conflict/run.jet:4:7
    |
  4 |     b.contribute("cache_slots", 2)
    |       ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `fact_contribution_conflict.build` writes 1 at 70:80; `fact_contribution_conflict.build` writes 2 at 105:115.
 Fix: Make same-layer writers agree, or move one value to a more explicit contribution layer
